title: cleome linophylla
intro: Cleome linophylla, commonly known as Spider Flower, is a plant species belonging to the Cleomaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The health benefits of Cleome linophylla include its ability to soothe skin irritations and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and promoting healing.
